### Checklist
- [ ] Pack file is valid YAML in `configs/community/`
- [ ] Includes `name`, `slug`, `description`, `author`, `tags`
- [ ] Includes at least one of: `modules`, `policies`, `alerts`, `routes`
- [ ] Tested locally with `stockyard` binary
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys or secrets
- [ ] Description explains what the pack does and when to use it
